name: List and Read Repository Issues
description: List issues from a GitHub repository with full details. Handles the list+detail pattern: first lists issues matching filters, then fetches each issue's full content including labels, assignees, and comments.

state.description: Filter by state: open, closed, or all

labels.description: Comma-separated list of label names to filter by

assignee.description: Filter by assignee username. Use '*' for any, 'none' for unassigned.

sort.description: Sort by: created, updated, or comments

includeComments.description: Fetch comments for each issue (adds one API call per issue)

steps.name: Filter out pull requests (GitHub returns PRs in issues endpoint)
